content:
Welcome back to this week's Apple Certified Refurbished Store new arrivals update. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, allowing you to purchase Apple products directly from Apple's official website at up to 15% off.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Outstanding quality, great prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be added to your purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every new arrival and price drop at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store so you don't have to. Stock changes quickly, and we hope this report can help you find available products before your desired items sell out.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain my top picks for value. Both are excellent choices for users joining the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to Apple Silicon.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $699)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago we first reported that the Studio Display XDR was in stock at the Apple Refurbished Store. As we've been reminding everyone, stock can change quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and a tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and a tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The long-out-of-stock basic Apple TV 4K is back this week, along with the higher-end Ethernet version that has been consistently available. You'll want to act fast if you want one — the basic version typically sells out quickly.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi plus Ethernet: $209 (originally $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear my Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day, and if you'd like to join the club, the Apple Refurbished Store has some great deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean band: $679 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue Ocean band: $679 (originally $799)

As always, you can head to 9to5Tocks to keep up with the latest Apple deals throughout the week.
